sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "servings" REAL NOT NULL, "prep_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "cook_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "cuisine" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cooked', "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "photo_url" TEXT NULL, "icon_svg" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_sections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Main', "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_ingredients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "raw_text" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_canonical" REAL NULL, "quantity_kind" TEXT NULL, "quantity_unit" TEXT NULL, "prep_note" TEXT NULL, "is_optional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_optional" IN (0, 1)), "needs_no_match" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_no_match" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_steps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "step_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "timer_seconds" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_favorites" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "recipe_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_collections" ("collection_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("collection_id", "recipe_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "store_tag" TEXT NULL, "walmart_item_id" TEXT NULL, "pack_canonical" REAL NULL, "pack_kind" TEXT NULL, "pack_unit" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "menu_group" TEXT NULL, "menu_order" INTEGER NULL, "grams_per_millilitre" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "macros_overridden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("macros_overridden" IN (0, 1)), "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_zero_calorie" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_zero_calorie" IN (0, 1)), "is_modifier" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_modifier" IN (0, 1)), "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_serving_options" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_canonical" REAL NOT NULL, "amount_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_unit" TEXT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "carb_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "sodium_mg" REAL NULL, "cholesterol_mg" REAL NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_modifier" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_modifier" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_plan_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("user_id", "day"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_plan_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES meal_plan_days (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "meal_slot" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "servings" REAL NOT NULL, "is_planned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_planned" IN (0, 1)), "is_logged" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_logged" IN (0, 1)), "logged_at" INTEGER NULL, "macro_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "macro_targets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "week_start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carb_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "sodium_mg" REAL NULL, "cholesterol_mg" REAL NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("user_id", "week_start_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ingredient_matches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ingredient_string" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES foods (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "needs_no_match" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_no_match" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("household_id", "ingredient_string"), CHECK (NOT ((food_id IS NOT NULL) AND needs_no_match)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cook_timers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "step_number" INTEGER NULL, "step_id" TEXT NULL, "elapsed_when_paused_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "recipe_title" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_profiles" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "calories_per_meal_target" REAL NULL, "protein_target_g" REAL NULL, "preferred_meal_types" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "dietary_preferences" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "dislikes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "allergies" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preferences" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cook_sessions" ("recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_step" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "checked_step_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("recipe_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipe_photos" ("recipe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recipes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_name" TEXT NULL, "remote_path" TEXT NULL, "sync_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_error" TEXT NULL, "attempted_path" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("recipe_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "entries" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_writes" ("sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "queued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_list_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_canonical" REAL NULL, "planned_kind" TEXT NULL, "planned_unit" TEXT NULL, "planned_rest" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "wanted_canonical" REAL NULL, "wanted_kind" TEXT NULL, "wanted_unit" TEXT NULL, "on_hand_canonical" REAL NULL, "on_hand_kind" TEXT NULL, "on_hand_unit" TEXT NULL, "checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("checked" IN (0, 1)), "is_manual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_manual" IN (0, 1)), "has_unquantified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_unquantified" IN (0, 1)), "store_tag" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source_recipe_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
